    Hi! This is the soundtrack album for the Breach mode of the video game Deus Ex: Mankind Divided.

    This album used to be downloadable from the composer Ed Harrison's SoundCloud page in FLAC 16 Bit / 48 kHz for free but sadly that is no longer the case. And while the album can be found in other corners of the internet in lossless form, there also used to be an alternative composition for the 10th track in the album (hence "& bonus track") which is no longer available on SoundCloud nor anywhere else as far as I can tell. Luckily that bonus track (which is 24 Bit / 48 kHz compared to the rest) has been downloaded by yours truly back in the day so here's the soundtrack album in its complete form!

    In addition to the cover art sourced from SoundCloud, you'll also find a background image for use with stuff like Plex.

    Enjoy!
